mutants.name: sequence bound takes max
mutants.old: | seq a b     => a.latencyBound contracts + b.latencyBound contracts
mutants.new: | seq a b     => max (a.latencyBound contracts) (b.latencyBound contracts)

mutants.name: rejection never reported
mutants.old: if events == reported then cell.firstRejection rest (history ++ events) (i + 1)
mutants.new: if true then cell.firstRejection rest (history ++ events) (i + 1)

mutants.name: scrub forgets the map
mutants.old:
match map.forward e.subject with
  | none   => .error .unknownSubject
  | some s => .ok { id := e.id, causation := e.causation, correlation := e.correlation,
                    version := e.version, subject := s, recordedAt := e.recordedAt,
                    payload := tokenize e.payload }
